answer: The furnace never cools, and the blower works the pipe in turns, gathering, blowing, shaping, annealing. Proof of glassblower certification via glass artists guild is a log of those turns: a certification the glass artists guild has renewed after every furnace exam. One invented piece needs a breath and a lie. A hundred need a hundred gathers, a hundred pipes the blower never held, and the horizon of each is the heat on his forearms — the haven is the annealer, cooling all night, the atlas the punty, left leaning by the furnace door.
